claims.claim: Every applicant aged 18 or over must attend a citizenship ceremony.
claims.quote: If you become a British citizen under the Windrush scheme you can choose if you want to attend a citizenship ceremony.
claims.note: The source makes attendance optional for the Windrush scheme and also lists citizenship categories that do not require a ceremony.

claims.claim: People who attend a citizenship ceremony attend it in person.
claims.quote: You must take your invitation when you go to your ceremony.
claims.note: The source describes going to the ceremony with the invitation.

claims.claim: A child under 18 who applied with their parents may attend a parent’s citizenship ceremony.
claims.quote: Children under 18 who have applied with their parents may attend a ceremony with other members of the family, to collect their certificate.
claims.note: The source expressly allows children to attend with family.
